5964928.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Colorado
5964928.note: Its own tribute page (5 Sept 2023, read through Firecrawl): 'Rabbi Popack founded Chabad Lubavitch of Colorado in 1978 and served as its director until his passing in 2022.' Medium: a text quoted on Waymarking (https://www.waymarking.com/waymarks/WM8BFJ_Chabad_Lubavitch_of_Colorado_Denver_CO) says 'Merkos Linyonei Chinuch - Lubavitch Colorado branch, was established in 1979, with a presence in central Denver.' This listing only went up in 2023; the organization is far older.

117582.name: Bais Menachem
117582.note: A Chabad of Colorado text quoted on Waymarking: 'Our synagogue, Bais Menachem, opened in 2000 under the leadership of Rabbi Yisroel Engel, with daily services and classes.' Medium: a secondary site quoting it. The Engels themselves have been in Denver since 1982 (CrownHeights.info, 2 Dec 2025).

118491.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Southern Colorado
118491.note: CrownHeights.info, 19 Jan 2009: 'Rabbi Moshe Liberow who has been on Shlichus in the area since 2001'.

117581.name: Boulder County Center for Judaism
117581.note: COLlive, 21 June 2024 (read through Firecrawl), Rabbi Pesach and Chanie Scheiner: 'By the time we moved on shlichus in 1991 ...'; 'the 33 years since we first moved.' The Daily Times-Call on CrownHeights.info, 18 Apr 2006: 'In Boulder, Chabad Lubavitch of Boulder County is in its 15th year.'

118422.name: Jewish Community Center - Chabad of Aspen
118422.note: Intermountain Jewish News, 27 Mar 2014: 'The young couple visited Aspen in March, 2000, for 10 days'; 'THE Mintzes took on the challenge and moved to Aspen in the summer of 2000.'

118621.name: Chabad Jewish Center - South Metro Denver
118621.note: Intermountain Jewish News, 21 Aug 2014 ('Mazel tov on 10 years of Judaism in Douglas County'): 'Then, in 2004, along came Rabbi Avraham and Hindy Mintz, a young Chabad couple with the idea of starting a Jewish center in northern Douglas County', first in a rented storefront; 'In 2009, five years after the Mintzes came to Denver', they built Douglas County's first synagogue.

118641.name: Chabad Westminster
118641.note: CrownHeights.info, 17 Apr 2009: 'It was five and a half years ago when London-born Rabbi Brackman, 37, and wife, Leah, co-founder and co-director, ventured from Brooklyn, N.Y., to Westminster with the intent of establishing' a Chabad House. Medium: counted back (about late 2003).

293100.name: Rohr Chabad Center at University of Colorado
293100.note: The Daily Times-Call on CrownHeights.info, 18 Apr 2006: 'Chabad at CU opened at the University of Colorado at Boulder in September.' Its chabad.org listing went up 29 June 2005.

292755.name: Chabad of Northern Colorado
292755.note: Chabad.org, 1 May 2012 (read through Firecrawl): Rabbi Yerachmiel Gorelik, co-director of the Rohr Chabad Jewish Center of Northern Colorado and Colorado State University, 'arrived on campus in 2005.' Its chabad.org listing went up 28 June 2005.

339297.name: Jewish Community Center - Chabad Vail
339297.note: Lubavitch.com, 9 Jan 2017: 'Rabbi Dovid Mintz, who started Chabad Vail with his wife Doba in 2006'. The Vail Daily on CrownHeights.info, 19 May 2006, writes of 'the new Chabad Center of the Vail Valley'. Medium: its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on 20 Dec 2005.

432259.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Longmont
432259.note: The Daily Times-Call on CrownHeights.info, 18 Apr 2006: Rabbi Yakov and Shayna Borenstein 'will move to Longmont from Brooklyn, N.Y., in early September to start a Chabad center'. CrownHeights.info, 29 Sept 2008: 'Rabbi Yakov Borenstein started the Chabad Jewish Center two years ago after moving to Longmont'. Its chabad.org listing went up 3 Oct 2006.
